confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and draft-beer anchors are based on aggregated Hangzhou price data. Cocktail data is sparse; cocktail and wine estimates reflect the local bar-price premium over inexpensive draft beer. Accommodation values are holistic estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food and drink estimates are city-specific. Accommodation reflects a major East Asian business and domestic-tourism market with July travel demand.
